title: TextComponents combined with SpriteSheetComponents crashes
body:
Hi,
spawning a `SpriteSheetComponents` and `TextComponents` seems to always crash.
It errors with 
```
thread 'main' panicked at 'number of dynamic offsets (0) doesn't match the number of dynamic bindings in the bind group layout (2)', /home/sam/.cargo/registry/src/github.com-1ecc6299db9ec823/wgpu-0.6.0/src/backend/direct.rs:1323:35
```

To reproduce, add a `SpriteSheetComponents` to `examples/ui/text.rs`, e.g:
```rust
fn setup(mut commands: Commands, asset_server: Res<AssetServer>) {
    let font_handle = asset_server.load("assets/fonts/FiraSans-Bold.ttf").unwrap();
    commands
        // 2d camera
        .spawn(UiCameraComponents::default())
        // texture
        .spawn(TextComponents {
            style: Style {
                align_self: AlignSelf::FlexEnd,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            text: Text {
                value: "FPS:".to_string(),
                font: font_handle,
                style: TextStyle {
                    font_size: 60.0,
                    color: Color::WHITE,
                },
            },
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .spawn(SpriteSheetComponents {
            ..Default::default()
        });
}
```
Tried a lot, nothing seems to work. 
Am I doing something wrong or is this a bug?

OS: Ubuntu 20.04.1
rustc 1.47.0-nightly (663d2f5cd 2020-08-22) - also rustc 1.45.2 (d3fb005a3 2020-07-31)
bevy 0.1.3
